finalText: Verifier passes. All 12 remaining `db.query` call sites in `packages/` (in accounts, analytics, billing, catalog, orders, and support) are now migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used elsewhere. Left untouched: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` (vendored, overwritten on every upgrade) and `cache.query` calls (unrelated API).
